name: deployfleet-whatsapp-service
description: DeployFleet's own WhatsApp Communication Layer (WA-0) — a small, always-on gateway ported/adapted from Zuri (creativesites/Personal-Assistant), see docs/whatsapp-intelligence-architecture.md. Not part of the Next.js app; deployed as its own long-lived process (Railway, Fly.io, or an equivalent small VPS), never on Vercel — Baileys needs a persistent WebSocket and local disk, both incompatible with serverless functions.
